related.title: Modbus RTU：字元時間與訊框靜默
related.titleEn: Modbus RTU: character times and frame silence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學峰值預算50 ns；1 ms通過、5 ms失敗；本模型未計固定不對稱與讀取誤差，交付時分開列出。 ethercat_dc_sawtooth.csv、校正事件與峰值檢查 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 20 與變更 100 ns、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching peak budget50 ns:1 ms passes and5 ms fails; separately list omitted fixed asymmetry and timestamp error. ethercat_dc_sawtooth.csv, correction events and peak checks Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 20 and changed 100 ns, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學固定靜默3 ms在9600不足、19200足夠；驗收須依實際字元格式與baud重新計算，禁止固定沿用一個數字。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. A teaching fixed3 ms gap fails at9600 and passes at19200; recalculate for actual character framing andbaud.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成殘餘頻差20 ppm，校正間隔1 ms；擾動5 ms，校正瞬間假設偏移歸零。 名義式 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns；變更式 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs累加0.2 ns直到下一次校正，畫鋸齒相位；量測校正前最大值而非週期平均值。

合成11 bits/character，9600 baud；比較19200 baud，均以3.5字元計，並把界線與規格版本記錄。 名義式 3.5*11/9600*1000 = 4.01042 ms；變更式 3.5*11/19200*1000 = 2.00521 ms。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 先算單字元1.145833與0.572917 ms再乘3.5；從最後stop bit結束量到下一start bit開始。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic residual skew20 ppm, correction interval1 ms changed to5 ms, assuming zero offset immediately after correction. Nominal 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns; changed 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate0.2 ns every10 microseconds to the next correction and plot sawtooth phase; measure the pre-correction peak rather than average.

Synthetic11 bits per character at9600 baud, compared with19200 using3.5 characters and explicitly documented boundary/version. Nominal 3.5*11/9600*1000 = 4.01042 ms; changed 3.5*11/19200*1000 = 2.00521 ms. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First derive character times1.145833 and0.572917 ms then multiply3.5; measure from the last stop-bit end to the next start-bit start.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ARP：快取老化與廣播工作量
related.titleEn: ARP: cache aging and broadcast workload
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學峰值預算50 ns；1 ms通過、5 ms失敗；本模型未計固定不對稱與讀取誤差，交付時分開列出。 ethercat_dc_sawtooth.csv、校正事件與峰值檢查 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 20 與變更 100 ns、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

related.difference: 建立IP、MAC、最後確認時間表，按到期事件計數而非按資料封包數估ARP。
related.differenceEn: Build IP, MAC and last-confirmed time columns; count expiry events rather than data packets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成殘餘頻差20 ppm，校正間隔1 ms；擾動5 ms，校正瞬間假設偏移歸零。 名義式 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns；變更式 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs累加0.2 ns直到下一次校正，畫鋸齒相位；量測校正前最大值而非週期平均值。

ARP將協定位址映射到硬體位址；快取策略會影響解析流量，老化值由此教學情境指定。
教學基準：120/300 = 0.4 requests/s；對照：120/60 = 2 requests/s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic residual skew20 ppm, correction interval1 ms changed to5 ms, assuming zero offset immediately after correction. Nominal 20e-6*1e-3*1e9 = 20 ns; changed 20e-6*5e-3*1e9 = 100 ns. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Accumulate0.2 ns every10 microseconds to the next correction and plot sawtooth phase; measure the pre-correction peak rather than average.

ARP maps protocol to hardware addresses; caching affects resolution traffic and the aging values here are teaching choices.
Teaching baseline: 120/300 = 0.4 requests/s; comparison: 120/60 = 2 requests/s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
